payout_quote: Refer a Friend and Earn Up to $50 per New Donor! FOR RETURN DONORS... Refer friends to donate plasma through the OctaApp and earn up to $50! Get $25 after their first donation and another $25 after their second. (Official Octapharma Plasma referral page, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Paid $25 after the referred donor's first donation and $25 after their second; payments typically within 48-72 hours
eligibility: Octapharma return donor; referred person must be a new donor who completes donations; referrals made through the OctaApp
steps: Be an Octapharma donor with the OctaApp installed
Share your referral through the OctaApp with someone eligible to donate plasma
They complete their first donation - you get $25
They complete their second donation - you get another $25
Payments land on your card typically within 48-72 hours
catches: Your referral must complete TWO donations for the full $50 - one donation only earns $25
Amounts are 'up to' and may vary by location
You must be a return donor to refer - brand-new donors can't refer until they've donated
Your friend must pass the center's health screening - ineligible friends earn you nothing
There's a 7-day waiting period if they recently donated at a different company's center
biggest_catch: You only get the full $50 if your friend donates twice - and they have to pass the health screening first. One-and-done referrals earn just $25.
notes: DEMOTED by coordinator adjudication 2026-09-23: duplicate - same provider and same bonus mechanism already verified at R7502 (Octapharma, new plasma lane). Original: Official Octapharma Plasma referral page (octapharmaplasma.com/refer-a-friend/, crawled 2026-09-23): up to $50 per new donor ($25+$25). Repeatable per referral. Distinct from the new-donor bonus (up to $750/35 days).
maximize: Refer friends who are clearly eligible to donate so their first two visits complete cleanly - one donation earns you only $25, so the full $50 depends on them coming back a second time. Only refer people genuinely interested in donating plasma, never pressure anyone into a medical procedure.
